buttonStyle.description: Visual style of the notification button. - flat: Minimal icon-only style. Counter is never shown. - normal: Standard notification button. Counter badge appears if showCount is true and isActive is true. - enhanced:...

count.description: Number of notifications to display in the counter badge. Only shown if showCount is true, isActive is true, and buttonStyle is normal or enhanced. Ignored in flat style. Defaults to 0. Available when isActive==true...

showCount.description: Whether to display the notification count badge. If true, and the style is normal or enhanced and isActive is true, the counter badge is shown. Has no effect in flat style. Defaults to false. Available when...

isActive.description: Whether the button is in the active (selected) state. When true, the button uses the filled notification icon and applies the selected style (normal or enhanced). When false, the button always appears in flat style...

ariaLabel.description: Accessibility label for the button. Used as the aria-label attribute for screen readers. If the counter is visible, the label will include the count (e.g., "Notifications, 5 new"). Defaults to "Notifications".

iconName.description: The icon in the `icon` slot, by name (a bundled icon); empty puts none. Custom icon to display in place of the default notification icon.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
